Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 49

“Action is far inferior to the yoga of understanding, Dhananjaya. Seek refuge in that understanding. Wretched are those motivated by results.”

Wretched sounds harsh, but kripana means pitiable rather than wicked. Krishna sees the results-driven life as a hard bargain that someone has struck against themselves without noticing.
